biography.plain_text: Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani was Qatar's Amir from 1995 to 2013 and later its Father Amir. Trained at Sandhurst, he rose through the armed forces before serving as heir apparent and defence minister. He concluded an eighteen-year reign by transferring authority to his son Sheikh Tamim in a prepared transition.

long_biography.plain_text:
Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani established Qatar Foundation with Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, making education and research a defining public project of his rule. Education City brought international universities, research institutes and community programmes together in Doha, giving the initiative a permanent institutional base.

His government also introduced a permanent constitution and expanded national infrastructure. Qatar developed a wider diplomatic presence during his tenure, using mediation and international relationships to raise its profile. New media institutions gave the country an international audience, extending its public voice well beyond the Gulf region.
